stepTitle: Consider the model\n$$f_{\theta}(x)=\theta_0+\theta_{1}\cdot\text{veg}+\theta_2(\text{meat=beef})+\theta_3(\text{meat=fish})$$\nDetermine how each change below affects model bias and variance compared to this model. Evaluate the following statement:
stepBody: Adding degree $$3$$ polynomial features increases variance.
